tools.name: calculate
tools.title: Calculate with Numi
tools.description: Evaluate a math, unit conversion, currency, percentage, or date expression using the Numi calculator. Accepts natural language such as '340 GBP to USD', '15% of 200', '3 days from now', or '(4+5)*2 in hex'.

ai.instructions: Numi is a natural-language calculator. Use the `calculate` tool for arithmetic, unit conversions, currency conversions, percentages, time zone and date math, and number base conversions. Pass the user's expression through as close to verbatim as possible - Numi parses natural language itself, so do not rewrite '340 GBP to USD' into a bare arithmetic expression. Currency rates come from Numi's own live data, so prefer this tool over estimating a rate yourself.

evals.input: @numi how many minutes are in 3.5 hours?

preferences.name: use_numi_cli
preferences.label: Use numi-cli
preferences.description: Query numi-cli instead of the Numi app API. Keep this on: the app API is deprecated and does not work on Numi 3.34. Uncheck it only if you run an older Numi build where Alfred Integration still responds.

preferences.name: numi_cli_binary_path
preferences.title: Numi CLI Bin Path
preferences.description: Optional override for the numi-cli binary. Leave empty to auto-detect it from Homebrew or your PATH.
